The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's at step 9. It treated the 19-title list from the luisbrincos IMDb list (created years earlier) as the complete set of Daniel Craig movies. Every later availability check was limited to that list, so Glass Onion, which is absent from it, could never be found. The Orchestrator also declared the task complete at step 88 without checking whether the candidate set was complete.
